skill.name: frontend-design
skill.description: Create distinctive, production-grade web components, pages, and applications with a deliberate visual direction and polished implementation.
skill.summary: Build functional frontend experiences with strong visual identity, thoughtful interaction, and refined details.
skill.author: anthropics

security_audit.summary: All three static findings are false positives caused by ordinary frontend design guidance. The skill contains no system reconnaissance, prompt injection, data exfiltration, or other malicious intent.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 7 describes creating polished frontend interfaces. It contains no instruction to inspect the host, enumerate system data, or collect environment details.
Line 30 recommends distinctive typography and font pairing. It does not request system information or invoke any reconnaissance capability.
Line 34 lists visual background techniques such as textures and shadows. These are presentation suggestions, not instructions to inspect a device or environment.

content.value_statement: Generic interfaces often fail to reflect their purpose or audience. This skill guides deliberate visual direction and polished implementation for functional web experiences.
actual_capabilities: Defines a clear aesthetic direction from the product purpose, audience, tone, and technical constraints.
Guides implementation of functional interfaces using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Vue, or similar frontend technologies.
Recommends cohesive typography, color systems, spatial composition, backgrounds, and visual details.
Plans animations, page transitions, hover states, and other purposeful interactions.
Adjusts implementation complexity to suit either restrained minimalism or elaborate maximalism.
limitations: The skill provides design and implementation guidance but does not supply a reusable component library.
It does not guarantee accessibility, browser compatibility, or performance without explicit requirements and testing.
Distinctive font recommendations may require separate licensing, hosting, or fallback decisions.
Advanced motion and visual effects can increase implementation cost and should be validated on target devices.

use_cases.title: Launch a Product Page
use_cases.description: Create a memorable, responsive product page that expresses brand character while keeping primary actions clear.

use_cases.title: Refine an Application Interface
use_cases.description: Replace generic styling with a cohesive visual system, stronger hierarchy, and purposeful interactions.

use_cases.title: Explore a Creative Direction
use_cases.description: Translate a design brief into an intentional web concept with typography, color, layout, motion, and texture guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a responsive page for [product]. The audience is [audience]. Use [framework] and choose a clear visual direction that supports [goal].
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs a complete page from a short brief.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Focused Component
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a production-ready [component] for [context]. Include responsive states, accessible interactions, and styling that fits [brand attributes].
prompt_templates.scenario: A developer needs one polished interface component.

prompt_templates.title: Redesign an Existing Interface
prompt_templates.prompt: Redesign the provided [page or application]. Preserve [required behavior]. Improve hierarchy, typography, color, spacing, and motion for [audience and purpose].
prompt_templates.scenario: A team wants to improve an existing frontend without changing core behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Complete Visual System
prompt_templates.prompt: Build [application] in [technology]. Define tokens, layouts, responsive behavior, interaction states, and a distinctive aesthetic. Meet [accessibility and performance requirements].
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced project needs a coherent system across several screens.

output_examples.input: Create a responsive portfolio for an editorial photographer using a restrained visual direction.
output_examples.output: A working portfolio with image-led composition, refined typography, quiet transitions, responsive galleries, and clear project navigation.

output_examples.input: Redesign a finance dashboard for analysts who compare several metrics throughout the day.
output: A dense but readable dashboard with strong hierarchy and stable layouts.
A cohesive color system that distinguishes status without overwhelming the data.
Focused motion and interaction states for repeated analytical workflows.

output_examples.input: Build a playful event page with a memorable first impression and clear registration flow.
output_examples.output: A functional event page with expressive typography, controlled animation, responsive composition, and a prominent registration path.

best_practices: Provide the interface purpose, target audience, preferred framework, and important technical constraints.
State accessibility, browser, performance, and responsive requirements before implementation begins.
Review visual choices against real content and test interactions on representative screen sizes.
anti_patterns: Do not request visual novelty without explaining the product purpose or audience.
Do not add elaborate motion when it weakens usability, accessibility, or performance.
Do not accept decorative styling that leaves required states and workflows incomplete.

faq.question: What can this skill create?
faq.answer: It can guide and implement web components, pages, applications, and interface redesigns using common frontend technologies.

faq.question: Which frameworks does it support?
faq.answer: It can work with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Vue, and other frameworks specified in the request.

faq.question: Does it improve existing interfaces?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the current implementation and identify behavior, content, or technical constraints that must remain.

faq.question: Does it handle responsive design?
faq.answer: Yes. Include target devices, breakpoints, and content constraints so responsive behavior can be designed and tested.

faq.question: Does it guarantee accessibility?
faq.answer: No. Specify the required accessibility standard and verify the result with automated checks and manual testing.

faq.question: How do I get the strongest result?
faq.answer: Provide audience, purpose, brand attributes, real content, technical constraints, and examples of required interactions.
